items.title: XOR'ing a register with itself is the idiom for zeroing it out. Why not sub?
items.title_zh: 用 XOR 把寄存器清零的惯用法：为什么不用 sub？
items.summary: Citing a short article by Matt Godbolt, the post explains that x86 compilers favor xor eax, eax because it is the most compact way to zero a register, several bytes shorter than mov eax, 0, which must encode a four-byte constant. x86 has no dedicated zero register, so registers must be cleared explicitly.

items.title: A Comparative Analysis of ARM and x86-64 Laptop-Class Processors: Architecture, Assembly-Level Performance, and Energy Efficiency
items.title_zh: ARM 与 x86-64 笔记本处理器对比：架构、汇编级性能与能效
items.summary: A study compared an Apple M3 system with an AMD Ryzen 7 3750H system. The Ryzen platform was decisively faster on a branch-heavy Fibonacci benchmark, while the Apple platform cut energy-to-solution by roughly 5.82x on Fibonacci and 6.38x on matrix multiplication, which showed no meaningful timing advantage for either platform.

items.title: Cross-Session Threats in AI Agents: Benchmark, Evaluation, and Algorithms
items.title_zh: AI 智能体的跨会话威胁：基准、评估与算法
items.summary: The paper argues that AI-agent guardrails judge each message in isolation, letting an adversary spread a single attack across many sessions so that only the aggregate carries the payload. It introduces CSTM-Bench, with 26 executable attack taxonomies and two 54-scenario splits, and reports that both a session-bound judge and a full-log correlator lose roughly half their attack recall on the cross-session split, while a bounded-memory Coreset Memory Reader keeps its recall on both.

items.title: Evaluating CUDA Tile for AI Workloads on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs
items.title_zh: 在 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 上评估 CUDA Tile 的 AI 工作负载表现
items.summary: An independent cross-architecture evaluation of NVIDIA's CUDA Tile finds that results depend heavily on workload and GPU: on B200 it reached up to 1007 TFLOP/s for fused attention, 2.5x FlashAttention-2 with 60 lines of Python, but the same kernel achieved only 53% of FlashAttention-2 throughput on RTX PRO 6000. By contrast, Triton delivered 62–101% of cuBLAS speed on every GPU tested, without tuning per architecture.

items.title: Benchmarking PNW Model for MedMNIST to 100% Accuracy
items.title_zh: 在 MedMNIST 上基准测试 PNW 模型以达 100% 准确率
items.summary: The paper introduces a concept called Artificial Special Intelligence for training classification models without errors, applying it to 18 MedMNIST biomedical datasets; all but three, which the author says suffer from double-labeling, were trained to perfection.

items.title: A Hierarchical Ensemble Pipeline for Anomaly Detection in ESA Satellite Telemetry
items.title_zh: ESA 卫星遥测异常检测的分层集成流水线
items.summary: A hierarchical ensemble pipeline for anomaly detection in multivariate satellite telemetry from the European Space Agency, combining shapelet-based and statistical feature extraction, per-channel modeling, intra-channel stacking and cross-channel aggregation. It is trained with time-series cross-validation and two-level masking to prevent information leakage, and results on the ESA-ADB challenge are presented as showing strong generalization.

items.title: PermaFrost-Attack: Stealth Pretraining Seeding(SPS) for planting Logic Landmines During LLM Training
items.title_zh: PermaFrost-Attack：通过隐蔽预训练播种在 LLM 训练中埋下逻辑地雷
items.summary: The paper introduces PermaFrost, a stealth pretraining-seeding attack that spreads small poisoned payloads across websites so they can be absorbed into future training corpora, remaining latent until a trigger activates them. It also proposes three geometric diagnostics for examining the resulting model behavior.

items.title: Dynamic Governance of Multi-LLM Agent Systems for Collaborative Conversational Outcomes
items.title_zh: 多 LLM Agent 系统的动态治理：优化协作对话结果
items.summary: The paper examines two LLM agents with structurally opposed objectives in a simulated financial-services setting, where the absence of a shared goal function leads conversations to collapse rather than compete. It proposes an Experience Orchestrator — a contextual bandit, a PID controller and a POMDP belief tracker — and reports a 32-percentage-point lift in high-intent advisor contact over a naive LLM control across 60,000 simulations, while cautioning that the findings are conditional on LLM-to-LLM simulation.

items.title: ZenBrain: A Neuroscience-Inspired 7-Layer Memory Architecture for Autonomous AI Systems
items.title_zh: ZenBrain：面向自主 AI 系统的神经科学启发七层记忆架构
items.summary: ZenBrain is a seven-layer, neuroscience-derived memory architecture for LLM agents that unifies fifteen mechanisms under one MemoryCoordinator. The authors report that with stronger decay over 60 days, most mechanisms become individually critical, and that ZenBrain beats Letta, Mem0 and A-Mem on all nine LongMemEval-500 answer-quality comparisons at a fraction of full-context token cost.
